filledFields.value: A sequence of eight scenarios played as Lord Ironfist, Lord Slayer, Queen Lamanda, or Lord Alamar.
An imperial servant and a former friend compete to retrieve an ancient artifact that will decide the empire's future.
Guide a royal dynasty through successive generations, defending the kingdom and defeating its rival.
Rival mages compete to control a newly emerged chain of magically powerful islands.
A shipwrecked traveler returns from remote islands and chooses a side in a civil war.
Catherine, Roland and Gelu oppose Lucifer Kreegan before he can assemble Armageddon's Blade.
Mutare challenges Ordwald for territory in Nighon and searches for blood that can transform her into a dragon.
Dracon trains as a dragon slayer, beginning with a Crystal Dragon and seeking an Azure Dragon.
Kilgor competes in Krewlod's leadership contest, fighting beasts and rival lords for a chance at the throne.
Adrienne returns to Tatalia to stop a Death Knight who is turning its people into undead.
A hurricane strands the young Christian on the Regnan Isles, where he helps local factions to secure passage home.
Crag Hack accepts Sandro's offer to recover four artifacts in exchange for gold, battle and a land title.
Gelu must assemble the Elixir of Life as his final test before entering Lord Falorel's service.
Yog leaves the Magic Academy for Krewlod and must disperse the Angelic Alliance as part of his initiation.
Gem settles in AvLee after the Succession Wars and helps Sandro collect artifacts for supposed research against necromancy.
Sandro carries powerful combination artifacts toward Deyja while his former master Ethric rallies enemies against him.
Four heroes uncover Sandro's ambitions and seek the Angelic Alliance to stop him.
Sandro develops another scheme against Antagarich with support from Lord Haart, the Kreegans and Dungeon rulers.
Destroys a visiting hero's cursed artifacts after payment.
Once per hero, grants a choice of +1 Attack, Defense, or Spell Power.
Teaches a password used to open the corresponding barrier.
Releases its captive hero into the service of the first player to free them.
Grants luck until the next battle.
Reveals the map around every Eye of the Magi.
Marks an area revealed when a hero visits a Hut of the Magi.
Once per hero, exchanges a proportion of the visiting army for experience.
Increases hero movement for a week and upgrades Cavalry to Champions.
